video_title: Nightmare Start For Knicks On & Off-Court With Ring Drama

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' ring distribution process and internal communication issues
quotes.excerpt: I'm not going to defend Jim Dolan. I don't want to even be accused of defending Jim Dolan.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I'm not going to defend Jim Dolan. I don't want to even be accused of defending Jim Dolan. All of those people are going to get their rings and they were going to get their rings. All of their basketball operations people, obviously I don't know if all of the sales reps who work for MSG are getting. You have to draw the line somewhere, and whoever the line gets drawn is going to be upset.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: How about the fishing email where he fooled company employees into thinking that they were picking out a ring and then they got called into the HR office, 'Hey, that was a cyber security test, you bozo.'

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Criticism of James Dolan's management of the Knicks' championship celebration
quotes.excerpt: How hard is it to suck the joy out of the franchise's first championship in 53 years?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: How hard is it to suck the joy out of the franchise's first championship in 53 years? It's this fishing email, it's the ring messiness, it's putting out a statement without any need to do so saying we're not negotiating with these guys anymore, it's declaring before the parade had happened that the second apron was like a lava pit that you would just burn up and go to hell if you stepped into it. I can't remember an owner sucking the joy out of the post-championship wake like this since Mark Cuban did it coming off the 2011 title.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: But there was a lockout. There was a lockout and then there's a new CBA and Cuban would snap, 'Have you read the CBA?' He thought he was smarter than everybody and he didn't resign or attempt to resign Tyson Chandler or JJ Barea.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: James Dolan's poor optics regarding the Knicks' championship rings
quotes.excerpt: The championship ring is bait. Even the Knicks admitted that's a bad look.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: They used the freaking championship ring is bait. Even the Knicks admitted that's a bad look. Even the freaking Knicks PR, which is basically coming straight from James Dolan, had to admit like, 'Yeah, that looks pretty bad, that was a crappy thing to do.' James Dolan was one of the NBA's biggest villain for the vast majority of his tenure. He was one of the most despised people in New York City and he's done a great job of reminding people just why they despised him in the first place.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' historical success despite poor ownership
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks won a championship despite having a bad owner. They overcame bad ownership to win a championship.
quotes.quote: The Knicks won a championship despite having a bad owner. They overcame bad ownership to win a championship.
